why: Серия «Балкон до и после», формула преображения «пустой балкон — уютное место» донора с 7,7 млн просмотров и ваш ролик «балкон + пергола» с 47 тыс. Цель — охват и заявки на замер балкона.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames at 7.1-8.4s show abstract pink/yellow smear and blurry glass close-ups with no clear balcony or glazing context, they look like a decorative glass panel or an unrelated product
Frames at 7.1-8.4s are near-identical soft-focus pictures, which feels static and out of focus

Subtitles at 4.5-5.8s are cut mid-phrase, and the end frame at 9.7s is a plain dark card with small CTA text
qa.fix: Replace the abstract close-ups with clear shots of the glass sliding open and closed on the balcony, show the dusty before state in the first second, and end on a glazed balcony with a big WhatsApp CTA over it.
